_about: MDP parameters per testplan.md §2.2 and §3. Auth zone is deterministic (drop-token-if-any -> Login) and has no weighted actions, so it is not listed under zones.

confirmation._comment: Action weights when entering the Confirmation zone.

transaction._comment: Initial action weights. LinkBank fades linearly to 0 as banks are linked; the lost weight is shifted to Transfer (testplan §3). Once all K banks are linked, LinkBank is excluded.

transitions._comment: Zone transition weights. From Auth, the only edge is -> Confirmation (Login). From Confirmation, only -> Transaction. From Transaction: stay 0.60 / return 0.40.

linkedBanks._comment: Per-account K ~ uniform integer [kMin, kMax]. LinkBank can be executed at most K times per account; lifetime cap, not reset by logout.

money._comment: Valid amount ~ uniform int in [minAmount, maxAmount] (VND). Deliberate overdraw amount = knownBalance + rand(1, overflowExtra), lowered to minAmount if knownBalance is too small.

_tokenTimeoutJitterComment: JWT T ~ Normal(mu, jitter*mu) clipped to [mu(1-jitter), mu(1+jitter)]. mu is per-profile.
_insufficientBalanceComment: Per Transfer/Withdraw call, chance of deliberately exceeding knownBalance. Next action in Transaction zone is forced to TopUp (testplan §3).
